So it can be used as follows:\n!store4.location := Location(14.0, 289.0)\n\n-- Enums usage:\n    -- enum Type { Clothes, Shoes }\n-- Can be used as follows:\n!store4.type := #Clothes\n</syntax_reference>\n"

"content" : "Create an instance for the following domain model:\n<domain_model>\nmodel VideoClub\n\ndataType Date\noperations\n    Date(date : String)\nend\n\nenum Genre { \n    Action, \n    Comedy\n}\n\nclass Client\nattributes\n    clientId : Integer\n    isSuspended : Boolean\nend\n\nclass Rental\nattributes\n    date : Date\nend\n\nclass Cassette\nattributes\n    title : String\n    availableCopies : Integer\nend\n\nclass Movie < Cassette\nattributes\n    genre : Genre\nend\n\nclass Series < Cassette\nattributes\n    episode : Integer\nend\n\nclass Actor\nattributes\n    name : String\nend\n\nassociation ClientRental between\n    Client [1] role assigned\n    Rental [*] role gets\nend\n\nassociation RentalCassette between\n    Rental [*] role borrowed\n    Cassette [1..*] role borrows\nend\n\nassociation CassetteActor between\n    Cassette [*] role actsIn\n    Actor [1..*] role has\nend\n\nconstraints\ncontext Client inv positiveClientId:\n    self.clientId > 0\n\ncontext Cassette inv postiveAvailableCopies:\n    self.availableCopies >= 0\n\ncontext Series inv positiveEpisode:\n    self.episode > 0\n</domain_model>\n"

So it can be used as follows:\n!store4.location := Location(14.0, 289.0)\n\n-- Enums usage:\n    -- enum Type { Clothes, Shoes }\n-- Can be used as follows:\n!store4.type := #Clothes\n</syntax_reference>\n"

So it can be used as follows:\n!store4.location := Location(14.0, 289.0)\n\n-- Enums usage:\n    -- enum Type { Clothes, Shoes }\n-- Can be used as follows:\n!store4.type := #Clothes\n</syntax_reference>\n"

"content" : "Create an instance for the following domain model:\n<domain_model>\nmodel VideoClub\n\ndataType Date\noperations\n    Date(date : String)\nend\n\nenum Genre { \n    Action, \n    Comedy\n}\n\nclass Client\nattributes\n    clientId : Integer\n    isSuspended : Boolean\nend\n\nclass Rental\nattributes\n    date : Date\nend\n\nclass Cassette\nattributes\n    title : String\n    availableCopies : Integer\nend\n\nclass Movie < Cassette\nattributes\n    genre : Genre\nend\n\nclass Series < Cassette\nattributes\n    episode : Integer\nend\n\nclass Actor\nattributes\n    name : String\nend\n\nassociation ClientRental between\n    Client [1] role assigned\n    Rental [*] role gets\nend\n\nassociation RentalCassette between\n    Rental [*] role borrowed\n    Cassette [1..*] role borrows\nend\n\nassociation CassetteActor between\n    Cassette [*] role actsIn\n    Actor [1..*] role has\nend\n\nconstraints\ncontext Client inv positiveClientId:\n    self.clientId > 0\n\ncontext Cassette inv postiveAvailableCopies:\n    self.availableCopies >= 0\n\ncontext Series inv positiveEpisode:\n    self.episode > 0\n</domain_model>\n"
